title: Best of Nordic | Exploring Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway
highlights: Experience the charm of Scandinavia, from  Stockholm's historic grandeur to Copenhagen’s vibrant life, Helsinki’s modern elegance, and Oslo’s natural beauty.
Explore the Suomenlinna Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage site, offering stunning panoramic views of the Baltic Sea.
Embark on a train journey from Myrdal to Flam, passing through lush valleys and dramatic fjords, showcasing Norway's most spectacular natural scenery.
Take a ride on the Floibanen Funicular to Mount Floyen in Bergen for panoramic views of the city and surrounding fjords.
Enjoy a classic Copenhagen Sightseeing Canal Tour, gliding through picturesque waterways and admiring the colorful buildings of Nyhavn.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Helsinki | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Finland! Upon arrival at Helsinki Airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check in and enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure, exploring the vibrant capital city of Helsinki. You can visit the Museum of Contemporary Art Kiasma, renowned for its cutting-edge exhibitions and striking architecture. Additionally, you wander through the lively Market Square and shop for Finnish crafts. Don't miss the unique Temppeliaukio Church, carved into solid rock. Later, return to your hotel.

days.title: Helsinki and Suomenlinna Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the Market Square and board the transfer for Helsinki sightseeing tour. Visit the stunning Helsinki Cathedral and stroll along the elegant Esplanadi boulevard. Explore more sites including the Uspenski Cathedral and the National Museum of Finland. Later, take a scenic boat ride to Suomenlinna Sea Fortress, where you'll visit the memorial tomb of Augustin Ehrensvard, the fortress's founder. Later, get driven back to the meeting point and then, head back to your hotel.

items.title: Helsinki and Suomenlinna Sightseeing Tour on a Shared basis

days.title: Helsinki to Stockholm Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Today, check out from your hotel and head to Helsinki Port. Board your luxurious cruise ship and start sailing towards Stockholm. check in to your cabins and enjoy the ship's elegant amenities, including fine dining options, a variety of entertainment choices, and panoramic views of the Baltic Sea. Enjoy your overnight stay on this delightful maritime adventure.

days.title: Arrival in Stockholm | Stockholm Hop on Hop Off Bus Tour
days.desc: Today, check out and disembark from the cruise. After arriving at Stockholm Port, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check in and later, head to the nearest pickup point to board your hop-on, hop-off bus tour. Explore various top attractions such as the majestic City Hall, the Skansen Open Air Museum, and the impressive Vasa Museum, among others. Spend the day discovering Stockholm at your own pace. In the evening, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

items.title: Stockholm Hop On Hop Off Pass on a Shared basis

days.title: Train to Oslo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After check-out, you'll be transferred to Stockholm Train Station for your journey to Oslo. Upon arrival in Oslo, you'll be driven to your hotel. Check in and enjoy the rest of the day exploring at your own pace. You can visit various sites such as Fotografiska, known for its contemporary photography exhibits, or the Moderna Museet, which boasts a rich collection of modern and contemporary art. Later, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

days.title: Oslo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, board your coach at Haakon Vlls Gate 1 and set out on an Oslo sightseeing tour. Begin with a visit to the Vigeland Sculpture Park, home to over 200 unique sculptures. Explore the historic Akershus Fortress and take in the stunning architecture of the Oslo Opera House. Discover the rich maritime history at the Fram Museum and enjoy panoramic views from the Holmenkollen Ski Museum. Afterwards, get driven back to the meeting point and then, head back to your hotel.

items.title: Oslo City Sightseeing Tour on a Shared basis

days.title: Norway in a Nutshell Tour
days.desc: Today, check out and get transferred to Oslo Train Station for your scenic journey to Myrdal. From Myrdal, embark on the famous Flåm Railway for a breathtaking journey through Norway's stunning landscapes. From Flam, enjoy a picturesque cruise through the Nærøyfjord to Gudvangen. Continue your adventure with a bus ride from Gudvangen to Voss, followed by a train ride from Voss to Bergen. Upon arrival in Bergen, you'll be transferred to your hotel, where you’ll check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bergen City Walking Tour | Floibanen Funicular Ride
days.desc: Today, embark on a guided walking tour of Bergen and explore its top landmarks, including the historic St. Mary’s Church and the grand Haakon’s Hall. Visit the Bryggen Hanseatic Wharf and wander through the quaint Steinkjellerbakken alley. Next, board the Fløibanen funicular for a scenic ascent to Mount Fløyen. From this vantage point, enjoy 360-degree views of Bergen’s harbor, surrounding fjords, and lush landscapes. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Floibanen Funicular Tickets on a Shared basis

days.title: Fly to Copenhagen | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, check out and get driven to Bergen Airport for your flight to Copenhagen. Upon arriving in Copenhagen, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day at your leisure. You can stroll through Amager Beach Park for a relaxing seaside experience, or marvel at the stunning architecture of the Copenhagen Opera House. Discover more of the city's charm as you wander through its picturesque streets. Afterwards, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Copenhagen Hop on Hop Off Tour | Copenhagen Canal Cruise
days.desc: Today, head to the nearest pickup point and board your transfer for hop-on, hop-off sightseeing tour. Explore attractions such as the beautiful Tivoli Gardens, the Nyhavn waterfront, the Rosenborg Castle and the stunning Amalienborg Palace. Don’t miss the opportunity to visit the stunning Fredensborg Palace. Enjoy a scenic guided canal cruise from Nyhavn Harbour, offering views of Copenhagen's most famous sites from the water. Afterwards, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
